dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いします)
dialogue.English: (Thank you; I look forward to working with you.)

dialogue.content: はじめまして相談員です。ご相談ありがとうございます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you; I'm the counselor. Thank you for reaching out. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: お願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 初めに年齢と性別教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: はい、41歳、女です。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm 41 years old, female.

dialogue.content: 悩みごとは、
dialogue.English: My concern is,

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。お話やすいところからお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. Please start wherever you feel most comfortable.

dialogue.content: 主人と価値観があわなくて離婚を考えてます。
dialogue.English: My husband and I don't share the same values, and I'm considering divorce.

dialogue.content: でもお金の問題で悩んでいます。
dialogue.English: But I'm struggling with financial issues.

dialogue.content: なるほどです。離婚を考えていてもお金の問題があると難しくなりますよね
dialogue.English: I see. Thinking about divorce becomes more difficult when there are financial concerns, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね、
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 今は主人が全て出してくれてる状態ですので。
dialogue.English: Right now, my husband is covering all the expenses.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そしたらなおさら考えないといけないですよね、、
dialogue.English: I understand... That makes it an even bigger issue to consider, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい…。
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 今は我慢してる状態です。
dialogue.English: At the moment, I'm just enduring it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、我慢はお辛いですよね、、ちなみになのですが価値観が合わないというのはどういったところでなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... It must be very difficult to endure that. By the way, in what areas do you feel your values don't align?

dialogue.content: 子供の教育のこともですし、家事の仕方も口うるさくて、小姑みたいでイライラします。
dialogue.English: It's about our child's education, and he nitpicks the way I do housework—like a meddlesome sister-in-law—which frustrates me.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、その中で今も離婚ができない状態の板挟みになっているのはしんどいですよね、、
dialogue.English: I see... It must be exhausting to be caught in the middle, wanting a divorce but being unable to go through with it.

dialogue.content: そうなんです！
dialogue.English: Exactly!

dialogue.content: どうにかしたけどなかなかできないとそれに対してもイライラしてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating when you want to change things but feel like you can't...

dialogue.content: そうですね、でもやっぱり我慢するしかないのかなぁと諦めかけてきてます…
dialogue.English: Yes, but I'm starting to resign myself to the idea that I just have to endure it...

dialogue.content: なるほどです。ちなみに金銭的な事情で今一番困っていることはなんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Specifically regarding your financial situation, what is your biggest concern right now?

dialogue.content: もし離婚したら？ってことですか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean if I were to get a divorce?

dialogue.content: 質問がややこしくてすみません。離婚したらです。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for the confusing question. Yes, if you were to get a divorce.

dialogue.content: うーん、やっぱり生活費ですね。
dialogue.English: Hmm, I guess it would be living expenses.

dialogue.content: でも教育費も大事だし、
dialogue.English: But education costs are important too,

dialogue.content: 選べません。
dialogue.English: I can't choose between them.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、いろいろ支出はありますよね、、やはりその中で離婚をしてしまうとのちのち大変になるかもしれないですよね、、
dialogue.English: I understand... there are many different expenses... It seems that getting a divorce under these circumstances could lead to difficulties later on, couldn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね、不安になります。
dialogue.English: Yes, it makes me anxious.

dialogue.content: お気持ちわかります。我慢もしなければいけないご状況とてもお辛いと思います、、
dialogue.English: I can understand how you feel. It must be very painful to be in a situation where you feel you have to endure so much...

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: まずはゆっくりお話し聞かせていただければと思います。
dialogue.English: First, I'd like to hear more about your story at your own pace.

dialogue.content: 離婚についてはご主人とお話されているのですか？
dialogue.English: Have you discussed divorce with your husband?

dialogue.content: いつも喧嘩になった時、私から離婚する！って言うんですけど、どうせできないでしょ？っていう感じで流されます。
dialogue.English: Whenever we get into a fight, I say, "I want a divorce!" but he just dismisses it, as if to say, "You wouldn't be able to do it anyway, would you?"

dialogue.content: それにも本当に腹が立つんですけど、私もいつも言うだけなので、
dialogue.English: That really makes me angry, but since I always just say it without following through...

dialogue.content: なるほどです、、その返しをされるとさらに嫌な気持ちになりますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see... Receiving that kind of response must make you feel even worse, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 私が使いすぎたのが、まずかったのかなとも思ったりします。
dialogue.English: I sometimes wonder if it was my fault for saying it too often.

dialogue.content: どういったところがまずかったと思われますか？
dialogue.English: In what way do you feel it was your fault?

dialogue.content: またか、と本気じゃないと思わせる原因を作ってしまったと…。
dialogue.English: I created a situation where he thinks, "There she goes again," and doesn't take me seriously...

dialogue.content: なるほど、、多用してしまったことで軽い気持ちに取られているかもしれないですね、、
dialogue.English: I see... Because you've said it many times, he may not be taking it seriously...

dialogue.content: そうです…。
dialogue.English: That's right...

dialogue.content: 本気で言っているのに伝わらないって悲しいですよね、、
dialogue.English: It's sad when you're being serious but it doesn't get through to him, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね…無力感が…。
dialogue.English: Yes... I feel so powerless...

dialogue.content: 無力感、、やるせない気持ちになりますね、、
dialogue.English: Powerlessness... it leaves you feeling helpless and stuck.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: お子様がいらっしゃるとのことですが何かお話されてはいるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you have a child; have you talked with them about any of this?

dialogue.content: いいえ、特に。でも喧嘩のところは見られてるので、嫌な気分にさせているとは思います…。
dialogue.English: No, not really. But they've seen us fighting, so I think I'm making them feel bad...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、お子様にも申し訳ない気持ちになりますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see... It makes you feel guilty toward your child, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね…。
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: ご主人とお子様の関係はいかがなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How is your husband's relationship with your child?

dialogue.content: 普通ですね、私との関係と一緒な感じで。
dialogue.English: It's normal—about the same as his relationship with me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: だからもし離婚となったら親権も迷うと思います。
dialogue.English: So if we were to divorce, I think I would be conflicted about custody.

dialogue.content: なるほどです、、親権についても喧嘩してしまうかもしれないですしね、、
dialogue.English: I see... You might end up arguing over custody as well.

dialogue.content: そうですね、子供に聞いても子供が辛いですね…。
dialogue.English: Yes, and asking the child would be hard on them...

dialogue.content: そうですね、、聞きづらいし悩ませてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: Right... it's hard to ask and would burden them with worry, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: その中でも我慢しなければいけないのはご負担になると思います、、
dialogue.English: Having to endure all this on top of everything must be a heavy burden.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: いつごろから離婚したいというお気持ちになったのですか？
dialogue.English: When did you start feeling that you wanted a divorce?

dialogue.content: 息子の手が離れた最近になってから特に思いますね。
dialogue.English: I've been feeling it more strongly recently, since my son has become more independent.

dialogue.content: なるほでです、、何かその時にきっかけや出来事はありましたか？
dialogue.English: I see... Was there any specific trigger or event around that time?

dialogue.content: 誤字失礼しますなるほど、、
dialogue.English: Apologies for the typo. I see...

dialogue.content: うーん、特にですね。いつも言われてることが重なってって感じでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Hmm, not really. It feels more like an accumulation of all the things he's always said.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、積み重ねだったのですね。すごくしんでいですよね、、
dialogue.English: I understand. It's been a buildup over time. That must be really tough...

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: その中で子育てや家事をやってきたこと本当にすごいと思います
dialogue.English: I think it's truly admirable that you've been raising your child and managing the household through all of this.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、専業主婦ですから…。
dialogue.English: Oh, not at all—I'm a full-time homemaker...

dialogue.content: 日々ストレスを感じてきた中でも負けずにやってきたことすごいと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it's incredible that you've kept going without giving up, even while feeling stressed every day.

dialogue.content: その中で今回ご相談きてくださってありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming to talk with me today, especially with all that you're going through.

dialogue.content: で、どうすればいいんでしょう❓
dialogue.English: So, what should I do?

dialogue.content: そうですね。今は別居などは考えていないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Are you not considering separation at the moment?

dialogue.content: ますますお金がかかるし、現実的ではないですね。
dialogue.English: It would cost even more money, so it's not realistic.

dialogue.content: 生活費がご不安とおしゃっていましたが別居の場合は婚姻費用として生活費を請求できる場合がありますので
dialogue.English: You mentioned you were worried about living expenses, but in the case of a separation, you may be able to claim living expenses as spousal support.

dialogue.content: 夫は離婚する気がないので。
dialogue.English: My husband has no intention of getting a divorce.

dialogue.content: なるほどです、、ご主人は離婚する気がないご理由などはお聞きしましたか？
dialogue.English: I see... Have you asked him why he doesn't want a divorce?

dialogue.content: そんなこと、プライドが高い人なので言わないです。
dialogue.English: He's a very proud man; he would never say something like that.

dialogue.content: なるほどです、、そう感じていらっしゃるのですね、、
dialogue.English: I see... so that's how you perceive him...

dialogue.content: もう一度別居を理由にお話ししてみるのも一つだと思われます。お時間になりましたのでこれにて終了させていただきます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Perhaps discussing a separation again might be one option. Our time is up for today, so we'll have to end here. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました。終了します)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. We'll conclude here.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)
